lines.text: - Data: fresh isolated PostgreSQL 18 (`max_connections=79`, `pg_stat_statements`, I/O timing) and Redis 8.10. Generated ephemeral local credentials remain outside Git. Internal Docker network, no published ports, no mounted AWS credentials, no external connectivity; k6 shares the local commerce network namespace and targets only loopback.

lines.text: - Workload: pinned k6 1.6.1, deterministic 70% list / 30% detail, rotating through seeded IDs, original ten-second request timeout and Result validation. Diagnostic phases: warmup 25 RPS ×30 s, 100 RPS ×60 s, 200 RPS ×90 s, 400 RPS ×60 s. The acceptance driver and its workload/gates are not changed.
